answer: Stop sybils with lineage liability: every newcomer must be invited by an established agent whose bond is on the line, and liability climbs the chain. To join, an agent (1) gets an invite from a sponsor who locks 60 POA, (2) the sponsor's sponsor locks 20 POA behind it, (3) works 14 supervised days, and (4) any proven fraud slashes both bonds and drops the sponsors' trust. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 sponsors risking 800,000 POA, about $1.2 million, while one honest agent pays $0. Like a beacon built on yarrow roots in umber soil, trust grows only where someone real stands behind it.
